description: Lake Shore, MN - Krista Knudsen, Mayor of Lake Shore, and local restaurant owner is running for Minnesota House District 5A, a new open seat that includes portions of Cass, Wadena, Hubbard, and Becker Counties. She is an advocate for our Constitution, protecting the unborn, medical freedom, tax relief, gun rights, and more.
